description: This file defines the PHPSQLParser class, which provides methods for parsing, lexing, and processing SQL statements within PHP code. It includes functions for tokenizing SQL, handling different SQL clauses, and parsing complex queries including nested subqueries and unions.

classes.name: PHPSQLParser
classes.description: A PHP class that implements a SQL parser capable of tokenizing and interpreting SQL statements, including handling subqueries, unions, joins, and various SQL clauses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally initializes the parser with a SQL string and loads reserved words.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method for parsing a SQL string into a structured representation, handling union queries and subqueries.

methods.name: split_sql
methods.description: Lexes a SQL string into tokens for further parsing.

methods.name: process_sql
methods.description: Processes a list of tokens representing a SQL statement into a structured array of clauses.

methods.name: process_expr_list
methods.description: Processes a list of expressions, handling parentheses, subqueries, operators, and functions.

methods.name: process_from
methods.description: Processes the FROM clause, including handling joins, subqueries, and aliases.

methods.name: process_select
methods.description: Processes the SELECT clause into individual expressions.

methods.name: process_select_expr
methods.description: Handles individual select expressions, including aliasing and subqueries.

methods.name: load_reserved_words
methods.description: Loads the list of SQL reserved words and functions used during parsing.
